Loa loa prevalence data from 197 village surveys

Source: R/data_definitions.R
loaloa.Rd

Prevalence of Loa loa (eyeworm) in a series of surveys undertaken in 197 villages in west Africa (Cameroon and southern Nigeria).

Usage

data(loaloa)

Format

An sf object with 197 rows and 10 variables:

ROW

row id: 1 to 197.

VILLCODE

village id.

NO_EXAM

Number of people tested.

NO_INF

Number of positive test results.

ELEVATION

Height above sea-level in metres.

MEAN9901

Mean of all NDVI values recorded at village location, 1999-2001

MAX9901

Maximum of all NDVI values recorded at village location, 1999-2001

MIN9901

Minimum of all NDVI values recorded at village location, 1999-2001

STDEV9901

standard deviation of all NDVI values recorded at village location, 1999-2001

geometry

Simple feature geometry (POINT) giving the sampling coordinates in degrees latitude and longitude

Source

Diggle, P.J., Thomson, M.C., Christensen, O.F., Rowlingson, B., Obsomer, V., Gardon, J., Wanji, S., Takougang, I., Enyong, P., Kamgno, J., Remme, H., Boussinesq, M. and Molyneux, D.H. (2007). Spatial modelling and prediction of Loa loa risk: decision making under uncertainty. Annals of Tropical Medicine and Parasitology, 101, 499-509.

Details

The coordinate reference system is 4326.
